svg.text: federated-non-shared-root: two departments under two independent roots - example/kubernetes
Cluster: kind, name spva-lab, namespace spva-lab. Cilium is the network plugin.
The segments below are NetworkPolicy, enforced by Cilium.
ingress: zone=lab, the own gateway, the peer gateway
ingress: zone=ml, the own gateway, the peer gateway
ingress: zone=internet, the peer zone, and the peer gateway

g.text: Signs with its OWN ROOT, from
answers for itself all the way up
authorities are minted once per laboratory
mint: gen_lab_certs makes the lab root and
mint: pvacms itself makes the ML root,
package: both roots, without keys, become
both roots, mounted into every IOC,
pods, so a restart is the same holder
Subject: CN=EPICS Lab Root Certificate Authority
Signs the Lab intermediate, which signs
Rotated independently of the ML root
Issued by: EPICS Lab Root Certificate Authority
Subject: CN=EPICS ML Root Certificate Authority
Rotated independently of the Lab root

svg.text: certificate authority - a file, mounted into a pod
minting Job - runs once per laboratory
Service - a stable name in front of a pod
PVA search and data, lab segment
PVA search and data, ML segment
a department reaching its peer, by name
peer certificate status, gateway to gateway
written by the Job / seeded by hand
use the same numbers; each is
app=, zone= : pod labels. A Service picks by app,
Only the department that issued a certificate can
SKID : subject key identifier - the full 40
A thick line is a segment or a shared address. Things
hang off it, marked with a dot where they attach.
A dashed line with an arrowhead is a certificate:
an authority signs, or a pod holds a file.
